articles.summary: Third Quarter 2026 vs. Third Quarter 2025 Highlights: Earnings per share increased 13% Net interest income (tax-equivalent) increased 6% Net interest margin (tax-equivalent) increased 15 basis points to 3.36% Negative provision for credit losses of $50 thousand, compared to a negative provision for credit losses of $255 thousand in 3Q 2025 Return on assets (annualized) improved to 0.99%, compared to 0.89% in 3Q 2025 Strong credit quality – Nonperforming assets to total assets were 0.02% AUBURN, Ala., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Auburn National Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: AUBN) reported net earnings of $2.5 million, or $0.72 per share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $2.3 million, or $0.66 per share, for the second quarter of 2026, and $2.2 million, or $0.64 per share, for the third quarter of 2025.
